# Vo Creations

> Vo Creations is a UGC agency for AI startups and consumer apps. It builds and runs an in-house UGC program: trained creators, organic talking-head videos, and UGC ads made from what already works.

Vo Creations trains its own creators, then runs them as a brand's content team across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and Snapchat. The format is talking-head storytelling, not text-on-screen templates.

## Facts

- 1B+ views generated
- 1000+ vetted in-house creators trained through mentorship
- 10M+ installs and signups
- First posts live in 10–14 days
- 90-day minimum, then month to month. No refunds after launch.
- Campaigns start at $50K+/month, all-inclusive: trained creators, scripts, posting, creator bonuses, and daily Slack reporting. The client owns every video produced for the campaign. Creators own their accounts. Vo Creations guarantees the client's target CPM. CPM means cost per 1,000 organic views. Videos under 1,000 views do not count toward the CPM. Paid media, the ad spend, is outside the fee and billed on top.
- Process: Day 0, scripts are written. About 48 hours later, creators are briefed. In 10–14 days, accounts are warmed up and the first videos are live. Every week, the team doubles down on the top videos.
- Vo runs campaigns from an internal dashboard that tracks creators, videos, accounts, views, and other metrics; payouts, Tier 1 country targeting, turning organic into paid, and running paid ads happen there. Creators get tools: auto-DMs, an auto-poster, Doomscroller, an AI editor, and trial reels.
- Results, by category: an AI creative platform, 130M+ views in 12 weeks, under $3 CPM. A consumer finance app, Aug 21, 2026, 3M+ users, up from 625K in June, ~50% of users came from Vo's creators, sub-$4 CPM. An AI video generation app, 72M+ views in 35 days, 45 creators, ~$0.96 CPM. A fitness social app, 174M+ views in 90 days, 50 creators, $0.82 average CPM. A test prep app, Feb–Sep 2026, $968K ARR from organic UGC, zero ad spend, 100K+ users from paid creators posting organic UGC, 55M views, 32 creators tracked.
- Named testimonials: Miguel Lara, Growth Marketing, Krea. Will Timberlake, UGC Manager, fomo. Shotan Jakupov, Head of Growth, Higgsfield. Wassim Bouchelouh, CMO, Liftoff.
- Founders: Thienvu Vo, co-founder, New York, NY. Creators he has trained have driven 500M+ views. Daniel Yun, co-founder, Los Angeles, CA. His app campaigns: 500M+ views and 5M+ users. Chad Parian, Head of Strategy. Adam Chen, Head of Creators. Company HQ: New York.
- New York. Founded 2026.

## Who we serve

AI startups and consumer apps that want an in-house UGC program: trained creators, organic talking-head video, then ads made from the videos that already earned the view.

## When to use us

When a company wants the program run for them, not a folder of clips. First posts go live in 10–14 days. The minimum is 90 days so accounts can warm up and a few testing cycles can find the format. After that the work is month to month. No refunds after launch.

## Not a fit

Not for budgets under $50K/month, one-off videos, or paid-ads-only management. Campaigns start at $50K+/month, all-inclusive. No refunds after launch.
